primary_antecedent.receiving_contribution: Compressed quantization, lacunary modification and boundary jet antecedents. The receiving source localization, weak graph passage and complete commutator reduction are independently proved from exact programme components.

source_correspondence: L0 retains the full normal-monic principal class, arbitrary complex lower matrices, actual weak trace and tangential-divergence source. It does not assume the source is globally L2.
L1 proves the Y1 and actual-adjoint bounds, Y-minus-one dual action and order-minus-one map to L2 using an explicit Fourier divergence representation, without gaining an ordinary normal derivative.

L2 constructs the actual lacunary symbol independent of the normal coordinate at the face. Normal-ratio and tangential proper cutoffs retain that exact property. Both boundary jet operators, including D_sigma a, are present.

L3 proves simultaneous H1 and second-normal graph density, continuity of the b-action in that graph norm and the actual weak trace identity. Both homogeneous domains are preserved before using the equation.

L4 retains every normal commutator coefficient, including N_minus_2, and all arbitrary matrix lower terms. Substitution of the original equation removes the second ordinary normal derivative, yielding the full L2 remainder.

L5 checks the rough-input parametrix remainder through the divergence representation and obtains an actual L2 source over the entire localized support. The full Green identity verifies the weak functional and its boundary condition.
L6 proves residual energy and L2-source bounds on one fixed inner region for every finite b-order. It makes no unsupported assertion of ordinary normal smoothing.

L7 uses the entire WSL lift, exact Robin solution/test transformations, ordered source multiplication and all local cutoff terms. Finite and all-order energy fronts are preserved while the representative source becomes genuinely L2.

L8 now applies the full matrix Cauchy construction and matched causal split to the localized natural-dual problem. General complementary boundary response, incoming microlocal regularity and sharp Airy mapping are explicitly still open.

Three complete exercises verify the boundary jet independently of the bulk error, the exact normal-dilation source term and an H1 lift with a non-L2 tangential divergence. Twenty exact checks and the original support/profile figure accompany the analytic proofs.
The proof map identifies the exact earlier programme prerequisites. Linked human components retain their authorship and licence notices.
